title: A kernel-checked exclusion certificate for Erdős Problem 647, to 10^8
summary: Erdős Problem 647 asks whether there is any n > 24 with max_{m 10^8. The exclusion is certified rather than searched at check time. A witness at a cover position is an offset together with prime-power pairs dividing m, certifying tau(m) >= prod (e + 1); every prime in a pair is below 1024 and is checked prime by eleven trial divisions, so no primality certificates appear anywhere.
